projects.title: Super Mario Bros Clone - Python Game Project
projects.description: This is a faithful recreation of the classic Super Mario Bros game, built entirely in Python using the Pyxel retro game engine. The project demonstrates advanced object-oriented programming concepts, game physics, collision detection, and sprite-based graphics rendering.

projects.title: SDBM-FULL-PROJECT: Autonomous Vehicle Control System
projects.description: This project implements a fully functional autonomous vehicle control system using the STM32L152RETX microcontroller. It provides both manual remote control via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and automatic operation with bidirectional obstacle detection, integrating motor control, sensor readings, and communication protocols.
